about.text: A pungent, aged labneh from Lebanon, made from raw goat milk in sealed earthenware anbaris jars over two to five months. Salt and milk are added in stages with whey drained off, then it matures 10 to 30 days, is drained in cloth and shaped into balls or kept under olive oil.

sources.text: The words on what it is and how it is made, from these.
